people.name: Jeffrey Michael Jones
people.bio_note: Managing Member, Principal, and CCO (100% owner) of Foothills Advisors. Arizona State University graduate. Began his financial career over a decade before founding the firm, starting in corporate finance at Wells Fargo/Wells Fargo Advisors, then gaining experience at two independent local advisory firms before founding Foothills Advisors. Focus areas include investment management, retirement planning, tax planning/preparation, strategic financing, and insurance design. Lives in Phoenix with his wife Amber and four children; enjoys guitar, running, cycling, and golf.
people.bio_source: foothillsadvisors.com/jeff (firm's own website states his marriage to Amber, four children, and hobbies -- guitar, running, cycling, golf -- alongside his independently-corroborated ASU education and sole ownership/CCO status via SmartAdvisorMatch).
